2607.06309.title: Token-Based Dual-view Fusion and Adaptation of Large Vision Models for Breast Cancer Classification
2607.06309.paper_summary: Accurate breast cancer classification from mammography requires effective integration of complementary information from craniocaudal (CC) and mediolateral oblique (MLO) views, which provide a more complete characterization of breast abnormalities. However, existing multi-view learning approaches typically rely on feature-level aggregation or single-stage cross-attention, which can entangle view-specific and shared representations and restrict interaction to limited network depths. To address these limitations, we propose a token-centric dual-view learning framework that unifies prompt-based adaptation and cross-view fusion within a frozen vision transformer backbone. The framework reformulates inter-view interaction as structured token-level communication, where dedicated fusion tokens explicitly encode bidirectional information exchange between CC and MLO views via cross-attention, serving as intermediate carriers of cross-view dependencies rather than relying on direct feature fusion. Unlike conventional methods that apply fusion at a single layer, fusion modules are inserted at multiple transformer depths, enabling progressive and repeated interaction across the encoder hierarchy. Fusion tokens are reintegrated into the token sequence and refined by subsequent transformer layers, facilitating hierarchical propagation of complementary information while preserving view-specific structure. Experiments on VinDr-Mammo and CMMD datasets demonstrate consistent improvements over linear probing, prompt-only adaptation, and conventional fusion baselines. On the VinDr-Mammo BI-RADS classification task, the framework achieves 50.40% F1-score and 0.8090 AUC, including a 0.10 AUC improvement over a dual-view fusion baseline in the binary setting. Ablation studies further validate the effectiveness of token-based fusion and multi-depth interaction design.
2607.06309.paper_summary_zh: 準確的乳腺癌分類需要有效整合來自頭尾（CC）和側面斜視（MLO）視圖的互補信息，這樣可以更全面地描述乳腺異常。然而，現有的多視圖學習方法通常依賴於特徵級聚合或單階段交叉注意力，這可能會將視圖特定和共享的表示混合在一起，並限制交互的網絡深度。為了解決這些限制，我們提出了一個以標記為中心的雙視圖學習框架，該框架在凍結的視覺Transformer主幹內統一了基於提示的適應和視圖間融合。該框架將視圖間交互重新表述為結構化的標記級通信，其中專用的融合標記通過交叉注意力明確編碼CC和MLO視圖之間的雙向信息交換，作為視圖間依賴的中介載體，而不是依賴於直接的特徵融合。與在單層應用融合的傳統方法不同，融合模塊被插入到多個Transformer深度，實現了編碼器層級的漸進和重複交互。融合標記重新整合到標記序列中，並由後續的Transformer層進行精煉，促進了互補信息的分層傳播，同時保留了視圖特定的結構。在VinDr-Mammo和CMMD數據集上的實驗顯示，與線性探測、僅基於提示的適應和傳統融合基線相比，均有一致的改進。在VinDr-Mammo BI-RADS分類任務中，該框架達到了50.40%的F1-score和0.8090的AUC，包括在二元設置中相較於雙視圖融合基線的0.10 AUC提升。消融研究進一步驗證了基於標記的融合和多深度交互設計的有效性。
